context: Yuki and Kenji finalize an event schedule.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: event planning; time vocabulary (時刻/開始/終了/同時に) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 開始の時刻は、決まりましたか?
lines.en: Has the start time been decided?
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 現在、午前十時で調整しています。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm focused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 終了の時刻は、何時頃ですか?
lines.en: Around what time does it end?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 終了は、午後三時の予定です。
lines.en: It's scheduled to end at 3 p.m.
lines.style: precise office man voice, soft warm focused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 受付は、開始と同時に始めますか?
lines.en: Does reception start at the same time as the opening?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いえ、開始の三十分前に始めます。
lines.en: No, it starts thirty minutes before.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm focused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 二つの会場で、同時に進めるんですね。
lines.en: So we run two venues simultaneously.
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、現在、人員を確認中です。
lines.style: reliable office man voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
